content_md:
## What Is Nightjar?

Nightjar (nightjar.so) is an AI product photography platform for e-commerce sellers. Upload product photos and Nightjar generates catalog-consistent brand imagery preserving logos text colors and materials. Key differentiator: catalog-wide consistency where image 100 matches image 1.

## Key Features for Print Shops and POD Sellers

### Catalog Consistency
AI ensures every product image in your catalog matches in lighting background and style. Critical for professional-looking storefronts.

### AI Fashion Models and Virtual Try-On
AI-generated models wearing your garments. Reduces return rates by showing realistic fit.

### Shopify Native App
Tight integration with Shopify for direct product image management.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Images/Month |
|------|-------|--------------|
| Free | $0 | 6 (trial) |
| Studio | $25/mo | 150 |
| Studio+ | $50/mo | 400 |

## Verdict

Use it if: You have 50+ SKUs and need consistent product photography. Strong fit for apparel POD sellers.

Skip it if: You need mockup templates (not photography) or have fewer than 20 products.
